title: Malmgren read into legacy UAP retrieval program by Bissell

tellings.quote: In the diary, Richard Bissell who founded Area 51, mayor of Area 51. was key to Harold Malmgren's claims that he was read into the existence of the legacy UAP retrieval program by Richard Bissell.

plain: A man named Harold Malmgren is said to have been told about a long-running secret program to recover crashed UAP, the official term for UFOs, by Richard Bissell, a CIA official who set up Area 51, the secret test site in Nevada. The Australian investigative journalist Ross Coulthart tells Michels that Malmgren's diaries are key to this, and that in them Bissell, whom Coulthart calls the "mayor of Area 51," is the man who brought Malmgren in. If true, the CIA official behind Area 51 knew of crashed craft being recovered.
